description: Retention and alterations to front boundary treatment to reduce the height to 1.5 metre high comprising beige stock bricks with reconstituted stone sills/capping and black painted railings and gates along the front (west) elevation and sides to enclose the property from the road.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The hereby approved alterations to the existing front boundary treatment shall be completed within three months of this decision.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( 038/AP2 04, 038/ AP2 02, 038/AP2 01, 038/LP01, 038/AP2 03 and 038/AP01b Rev B. Received: 19th September 2019 ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The hereby approved replacement reconstituted stone capping and sills to the existing boundary treatment shall be of a similar colour to the brick walls and pillars of the  existing boundary treatment.
Condition : 4 - The hereby approved boundary treatment railings and gates shall not, at any time, be filled in with solid panels.
